entries.title: Proverbs 4:1
segments: ¶Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:2
segments: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:3
segments: For I was my father's son, tender and only [beloved] in the sight of my mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:4
segments: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:5
segments: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget [it] not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:6
segments: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.

words.text: her not, and she shall preserve

entries.title: Proverbs 4:7
segments: Wisdom [is] the principal thing; [therefore] get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:8
segments: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

words.text: thee: she shall bring thee to honour

entries.title: Proverbs 4:9
segments: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee. {a crown...: or, she shall compass thee with a crown of glory}

words.text: to thee. {a crown...: or, she shall compass thee with a crown of glory}

entries.title: Proverbs 4:10
segments: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:11
segments: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:12
segments: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:13
segments: Take fast hold of instruction; let [her] not go: keep her; for she [is] thy life.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:14
segments: ¶Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil [men].

entries.title: Proverbs 4:15
segments: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:16
segments: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause [some] to fall.

words.text: not, except they have done mischief

entries.title: Proverbs 4:17
segments: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:18
segments: But the path of the just [is] as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:19
segments: The way of the wicked [is] as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:20
segments: ¶My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:21
segments: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:22
segments: For they [are] life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh. {health: Heb. medicine}

entries.title: Proverbs 4:23
segments: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it [are] the issues of life. {with...: Heb. above all keeping}

words.text: ; for out of it [are] the issues

entries.title: Proverbs 4:24
segments: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee. {a froward...: Heb. frowardness of mouth and perverseness of lips}

words.text: from thee. {a froward...: Heb. frowardness of mouth and perverseness of lips}

entries.title: Proverbs 4:25
segments: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:26
segments: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established. {let...: or, all thy ways shall be ordered aright}

words.text: . {let...: or, all thy ways shall be ordered aright}

entries.title: Proverbs 4:27
segments: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
